text.en: Shoppers consistently praise the retail staff for their friendly welcome, helpful advice, and pet food recommendations. Customers note that assistants go out of their way to support pet owners and greet visiting dogs with affection. While one reviewer experienced a staffing cancellation in grooming, the store team is widely appreciated.

Recent reviews reflect serious dissatisfaction with grooming quality, including shaved coats despite explicit requests against it. Multiple customers report uneven styling and damaged fur texture that left dogs unrecognizable upon collection. Although one regular client was delighted with her pet's styling, negative feedback dominates.

Pet owners value the store's extensive product selection, noting that shelves carry supplies and specialty diets often missing from larger chains. Visitors appreciate the convenient local setting and welcoming retail layout. On the other hand, one customer expressed disappointment that the shop does not carry live aquarium fish.

q.en: Does Mutz Nutz offer dog grooming services on-site?

a.en: Yes, grooming services are offered on-site, though recent reviews show mixed feedback regarding styling consistency.

q.en: Are pets allowed inside the Walkinstown shop?

a.en: Yes, customers regularly bring their dogs inside the store to browse pet supplies and greet the friendly staff.

q.en: Does the shop stock live fish and aquarium livestock?

a.en: No, the shop focuses on supplies for dogs, cats, and small animals and does not sell live aquarium fish.

q.en: Can staff provide nutritional advice for pet diets?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention helpful guidance from retail staff when selecting appropriate food formulations for dogs.
